examples.english: They are always scornful of others, so their colleagues do not want to work with them.

examples.english: They are always contemptuous, acting indifferent toward new colleagues.

examples.english: They are always acting like a professional and talking as if nobody else knows anything; they’re really disdainful.
examples.traditional: 佢成日扮晒專業，講到好似其他人都唔識嘢咁，真係好睇唔起人。
